title: regional-health-probe: override degraded-route routing for transient node flaps
author: Maya Chen
commits: ef3a7b2: initial implementation of degraded-route override API and in-memory dampening
b91cfa1: add safety checks for override lifetime and tenant-scoped invariants
4d2e9c0: integrate override decision into router with priority rules
7a10d4b: unit tests for policy precedence and transient flap cases
c3f9b55: bump config defaults and docs for operators
description:
Context: A recent incident (SUP-4032) exposed cases where short-lived node flaps in a region caused the local health-probe to mark large swathes of nodes as unhealthy, triggering aggressive degraded-route failovers and cascading capacity spikes in adjacent regions. This PR introduces a conservative override mechanism at the health-probe layer that prevents transient flaps from causing an immediate routed-degradation for multi-tenant customers while retaining fast failover semantics for sustained outages.
Motivation: We need to reduce noisy regional failovers and avoid expensive cross-region ramping while preserving our SLO-driven failover behavior for real outages.
Goals implemented: 1) Introduce a "degraded-route override" decision that can be set by the probe manager for a tenant-region pair to suppress immediate routed degradation for a short bounded window when flapping is detected. 2) Add dampening logic (exponential backoff with jitter) to extend override windows for repeated flaps and expire them quickly after stability. 3) Ensure override decisions are tenant-scoped and cannot suppress manual operator-initiated failovers or critical circuit-breaker actions. 4) Expose operator-visible metrics and an alert threshold so SREs can tune sensitivity.
Description of changes: - services/health-probe: new override API, dampening state machine, and conservative default config (see health-probe-config.yaml). The probe manager now computes an "override_decision" with fields {tenant_id, region, expires_at, reason} and surfaces it via the probe-status stream. - runtime/router: policy_override.go consumes override_decisions and applies a precedence rule: operator/manual > circuit-breaker > override > automatic-slo-enforced-degrade. This avoids override masking an operator outage directive. - Tests: policy_override_test.go includes scenarios for single-flap, repeated-flap with increasing override windows, and expiry behavior under restored health. - Observability: new metrics (health_probe.override_count, health_probe.override_window_seconds) and an alert that fires if override windows exceed 5 minutes for more than 2 tenants in 10m.
Migration and rollout: defaults are conservative (initial override window 8s, max 3 backoffs). This was behind a feature flag defaulted ON for regions with rolling probe versions >= 1.14. Operators can adjust via deploy/manifests/health-probe-config.yaml. CI: unit tests + integration harness for probe->router flow ran in CI; all checks passed (see ci checks summary below).
Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked in Linear ENG-7891 - [x] Feature flag gated - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] Observability and alert added - [x] Rollout plan in docs/ops/regional-failover.md
Rollout plan: staged to low-traffic regions for 24h, monitor health_probe.override_count and cross-region capacity spikes, then expand to remaining regions over 48h.
Risk assessment: low — does not change circuit-breaker threshold behavior and cannot suppress operator/manual failovers. However, a misconfigured long override could delay legitimate failover; alerting mitigates this.
CI checks summary: - unit-tests: pass - integration-probe-router: pass - lint: pass - static-analysis: pass - e2e-simulated-failover: pass
Review conversation (high level): - Diego Alvarez: "Please add explicit invariants that prevent override from suppressing operator-initiated failovers and document the tenant-scoping." (addressed in second commit and docs) - Priya Natarajan: "Can you make the initial window configurable via configmap and add a test that simulates clock skew?" (added configmap and a mocked-clock test) - Liam O'Connor: "Metrics look good; add an alert for runaway overrides." (added alert) - Maya Chen (author): "Addressed comments, added tests and docs; moved defaults to conservative values and gated behind the probe version check." Merge: squashed and merged to main after approvals from Diego and Priya.
Release notes: "Health-probe: add transient-flap override to reduce noisy regional failovers; conservative defaults enabled by probe-version gating. Operators can tune windows via config. See docs/ops/regional-failover.md for rollout guidance." Links: Linear ENG-7891, SUP-4032 incident writeup, internal runbook updated in docs/ops/regional-failover.md

notes_for_cherrypick: Low-risk backport to the 1.14.x branch recommended for regions still running older probe versions; backport should skip the docs changes and only include code + config defaults.
